messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the Canadian public‑holiday long weekends that fell in 2023.  
(Only the national holidays that create a “long weekend” are listed; provincial‑only holidays are omitted.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1–2** (Sun‑Mon) | Holiday on Sunday → weekend extends to Monday. |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, etc.)* | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Mon) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sun) | Friday holiday → weekend includes Friday. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Monday | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Mon) | Monday before May 25. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Mon) | Holiday on Saturday → weekend extends to Monday. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Mon) | First Monday in September. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Mon) | Second Monday in October. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Saturday | **Nov 11–13** (Sat‑Mon) | Holiday on Saturday → weekend extends to Monday. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Mon) | Holiday on Monday → weekend extends to Saturday. |

**Boxing Day (Dec 26)** fell on a Tuesday in 2023, so it did not create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific holidays or additional details, let me know!
